subject.title: improve(matrix): prove lifecycle parity across substrates

question: Should the QA Matrix substrate lifecycle helpers be exported from package-root `api.ts` as a public bundled-plugin API?
rationale: The implementation is reviewable as code, but automated review should not decide whether these new lifecycle helpers are a permanent plugin API contract.

options.title: Accept the public QA API
options.body: Merge the `api.ts` exports as the durable import path for Matrix QA lifecycle helpers.

options.title: Keep helpers private
options.body: Remove the package-root exports and keep lifecycle helpers internal to the QA Matrix tests until a public API is needed.

recommendation.title: Accept the public QA API
recommendation.body: Merge the `api.ts` exports as the durable import path for Matrix QA lifecycle helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent Matrix QA live adapter work and proposed the linked lifecycle API shape.
